scope: EXPOSED_RETROSPECTIVE_DIAGNOSTIC; model-side masked context on published ComBat-normalized data, not raw-assay isolation or independent biology
endpoint: Negative mean published PRISM HTS log2-fold-change of ten selected unmeasured drugs at exactly 2.5 uM; time and culture independence limited to source documentation
data: Metadata-only context identity and role assignment; reference response completeness >=95%; no development/evaluation response values or availability may filter the drug pool
task: Known drugs in a response-unavailable cell context. Public target basal expression is allowed; all response-derived prior features use reference contexts only
probe_design: Reference-only differential crossfit residual pivots from a fixed basal kNN15 model; same eight probes in every context and arm, committed before development outcomes
terminal_menu: All reference-qualified drug identity groups except the eight probes. Zero-purchase baseline uses this same prescribed future-drug menu
features: 256 reference-variance-selected basal genes, refit within five context-crossfit folds; rank-2/4/8 residual features learned only from reference crossfit errors
development_selection: Select strongest prior and each update family's setting by mean top10 utility on the common complete-selection development-context intersection within that selection family. Disclose excluded contexts. Lexical/config-order ties; freeze before evaluation probe release. No refit with development outcomes
missing_probes: If any of the fixed eight outcomes is missing, every update arm falls back to the frozen prior. Still charge eight attempted measurements and one round; no replacement, subset refit or retrospective refund
missing_terminal: Never filter the terminal menu or replace a selected drug using target availability. Null utility if any of ten selected values is unavailable. Retain all contexts and report pair-complete counts; any primary-pair missingness blocks a full-population benefit claim
price_basis: Utility per declared read equivalent, development sensitivity scenarios only; not laboratory prices. Historical basal acquisition common and not repriced; API calls zero, actual compute and procurement costs unavailable
primary_diagnostic: Lowrank minus paid_no_update on top10 utility; additionally compare conditional and shuffled control, and lowrank minus zero_purchase net utility across the full declared price grid
analysis: Paired context effects; lineage-cluster bootstrap as dependence sensitivity, not independent culture evidence. Nominal intervals are exploratory, uncorrected; no certified superiority, noninferiority or coverage claim
decision_rule: Report evidence, not a biological PASS. A positive exploratory signal requires complete primary-pair outcomes, positive lower cluster intervals versus paid no-update, shuffled and conditional controls, and positive lower net interval vs zero purchase at the declared 0.001 scenario. Otherwise do not advance the complex feedback branch based on this study
reliability: Selected mean absolute error, measured terminal MSE, missingness, changes in top10 and harmful/beneficial swaps are diagnostics only. No interval construction, JOMI, FCR or selection-conditional guarantee is implemented
audit: Freeze protocol/model/runner/data preparation and source hashes; commit evaluation predictions and identities before scoring terminal values; poison every unpurchased evaluation response and require identical fitted choices and decisions; offset selected identities must equal no-update; all arms same probe identities and costs
